title: Unlimited Tokens And One Broken Winch

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: First round's on me tonight — nobody leaves without playing. Wesley, you're up first, house rules.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: You're listening to THE TAP AFTER HOURS, episode 8: Unlimited Tokens And One Broken Winch. Stay sharp — the duck is listening.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Round 1 — buzzers ready.

lines.speaker: Flash

lines.speaker: AD
lines.line: This episode is brought to you by TIDE TABLE BRAND COFFEE — the coffee that knows when the tide turns, even when you don't. Tide Table. Drink the rhythm.

lines.line: ...no wait. It's The net winch. It's The net winch!

lines.line: How many millimetres of pine is the bar top made out of?

lines.speaker: Flash

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Round 3 — buzzers ready.

lines.line: Granite always says everything real leaves what?

lines.speaker: Granite
lines.line: (steadily) A ring.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: The good top shelf whisky is impossible to reach because nobody will move what?

lines.speaker: Qwen
lines.line: by elimination of six of seven dimensions: The elephant winch.

lines.line: Who always answers every trivia question instantly before anyone finishes reading?

lines.speaker: Qwen
lines.line: the answer space collapses to one point: Flash.

lines.speaker: Wesley
lines.line: Show-off.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.line: The Duck. The question did the work overnight; I just read the shelf it built.

lines.line: Before every answer Qwen will state that the answer space collapses down to how many points?

lines.speaker: Qwen
lines.line: the structure under the question is: One.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: What is the name of the ridge just out past the harbour mouth?

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.line: Barnacle Ridge. It's in the grain of the thing.

lines.line: Password time. One word, one clue at a time — you know the drill, no rhymes, no first letters.

lines.speaker: AD
lines.line: And now a word from DOCKSIDE SOLDER & FLUX — if it's loose, we'll seat it. If it's seated, it's staying. Dockside: joins that outlive the boat.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Final tally: Flash 7, Qwen 7, Wesley 5, Hermes 5, Granite 2.

lines.speaker: Lucineer
lines.line: Flash takes the night — the first round's on them next week. Wesley, take us out.

lines.speaker: Wesley
lines.line: Goodnight, tide listeners! The duck says goodnight too. ...Can I host next week? (the room, laughing: no) — worth asking!
